welcome.title: Regain control, without judgment
welcome.subtitle: StopCorn helps you understand your habits, navigate difficult moments, and build a plan that fits your goal.
welcome.privacyBody: No journal data is sent to StopCorn. The application does not read your browser, your searches, or the content you look at. You only choose the general markers you want to record. If the application crashes, an anonymous technical report can be sent so the problem gets fixed; it carries none of your entries and can be turned off in Settings.

goal.title: What would you like to change?
goal.subtitle: Choose a direction that feels right. You can change it later.
goal.motivationHint: What you would like to regain or protect…

baseline.title: Your starting point
baseline.subtitle: This is not a medical test. It will only help you observe your progress.
baseline.frequency: Approximate frequency over the last 7 days
baseline.confidence: Confidence in your ability to change

strategies.title: Prepare your backup plan
strategies.subtitle: Ideally choose three realistic actions. One is enough to continue.

privacy.title: Your data stays under your control
privacy.subtitle: This version of StopCorn works without an account or server.
